why: Owner review rejected 09 punch ('no sound'), 44 bow1 ('i can't really hear it') and 49 bird1 ('both have issues'). Measured on the delivered MP3s: punch -50.4/-42.2 LUFS (peak -27.7/-19.8 dBFS), bow -53.9/-41.2 LUFS (peak -36.9/-20.7 dBFS): the 0.5 s generations came back nearly silent; bird -5.8 LUFS with peaks above full scale (clipped). Owner asked on 16 Nov 2026 to redo them. Owner decision 16 Nov 2026 08:40 (relayed by the coordinator): redo 48 (axe) too.
rules: No song, composer or real person named. Generate at least 1.0 s so the model has room for a full transient, then trim. Reject any take whose peak is below -12 dBFS or that clips; prepare with tools/prepare_sfx.py (mono, leading silence trimmed, -3 dBFS peak); log every take in SourceAssets/asset_ledger.csv (tool, model, prompt, parameters, credits).
